title: Three hexoses with the same formula
caption: Glucose, galactose and fructose are all C₆H₁₂O₆: isomers. Glucose and galactose are aldoses (a –CHO at the end of the chain) and differ only at carbon 4; fructose is a ketose (a C=O inside the chain).
alt: Open-chain structures of glucose, galactose and fructose, each C6H12O6, with the carbonyl group shaded: an aldehyde on glucose and galactose, a ketone on fructose.
description: Glucose: an aldehyde group at carbon 1, so an aldose.
Galactose: also an aldose; the –OH on carbon 4 points the other way from glucose.
Fructose: a ketone group at carbon 2, so a ketose.
All three are C₆H₁₂O₆, so they are isomers.
